label: build S10 1/2
result:
S10 unit 1 is built and committed on branch `v2/s10`: the `/review/` hub works at 1280 and 390, and `/mistakes/` redirects to it. One thing is still broken: three links on the page lead to unit-2 pages that don't exist yet, and the "Walk them" page also needs a server change first. Branch is freed (detached HEAD at `ba272d1`); the only untracked item is `server/cache/`, which the server writes when it runs, so I left it out.

**Checks run**
- `server/checks/s10.py`: "S10 checks passed".
- `test_flow`, fresh `s10.db`: stops at the known date-dependent failure, `server/checks/s8.py` line 519.
- `test_flow`, default database: stops earlier, inside `server/checks/s10.py` (see the server list below).
- Browser: 29 interaction checks passed, no console errors.
  - Opening a row sets `open=` in the URL and survives a reload.
  - The pane's strip cells carry open/half/relapsed/stuck/sure.
  - Tab change and Back work; `topics=circles` filters and the list head reads "n of 48 match".
  - Every tab's primary button starts a set the server accepts (200).
  - Not today and Undo change the count; Start review starts a session; the inline twin runs; J moves the pane and X toggles the row.
  - At 390: every tab has `scrollWidth == 390` and 52px tall tabs; tapping a row opens the full-screen pane and Esc closes it.

**Files**
- `/Users/workingmyassof/freshbot/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_ca695ea6-8f2-1/web/review/index.html`
- `/Users/workingmyassof/freshbot/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_ca695ea6-8f2-1/web/review/review.js`
- `/Users/workingmyassof/freshbot/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_ca695ea6-8f2-1/web/mistakes/index.html`

**What's on the page**
- **Header:** the minutes seg saves `review_minutes`. The main button reads Start review, All, Fix n or Keep going; ▾ opens a preview where you can drop items. The meta line shows check-ins, quick wins and "closes up to". A new student sees only the empty state's Start button.
- **Notes:** the new-misses walk card (it says which sitting they came from) and a line when a worksheet is waiting.
- **Tiles as tabs:** the six stat tiles are the tablist, so each number appears once. This departs from the spec, which has a separate stat strip and tab bar; I merged them because the user's rules forbid repeating numbers. On a phone they become six sticky segments.
- **Tab heads:**
  - Due: today's card with ring, kinds, forecast, "n more wait" and the test-day sheet link.
  - Redo: named-mistake rate, why you lose points, habits and gauntlet, worth the most.
  - Marked: your instincts.
  - Saved: All / Due today / Learned.
  - History: summary, CSV download, right-but-slow block, rushed line.
  - Fixed: made-vs-fixed chart, forecast and stat line.
- **Lists:** filters are kept in the URL; Redo groups by topic, domain, habit or mistake type; rows show chips and points; History groups by sitting with rematch/fix/blanks buttons and discard/restore. Other row actions: Learn this type, note editing, unsave or unmark with undo, check-in state and Prove it at a harder level, Reopen.
- **Pane:** every callback is wired: seen, why, rule, save and why-saved, mark, story, related, spot the trap, share, ask for help, dismiss with undo, closed, twin answer.
- **Action bar:** options sit above the list; the sticky bar holds the summary and one primary. Set counts never exceed what the selection holds.

**I departed from the spec on these, following the user's 2026-09-28 rules:**
- No L1–L7 level filter and no levels shown in rows.
- No times of day in history lines; scores read "5 / 69".
- The Due tab has no action bar, since it would repeat the header button (the spec's V15 check 5 expects one).
- Figures that repeat another are hidden: the cause bar with only one cause, and the weekly change when it equals the open count.

**Unit 2 still needs:**
- `/review/walk/` ("Walk them" currently gives a 404), `/review/sheet/` and `/review/print.html` (error log).
- The Your rules view.
- Clicking the example row for a new student (it is inert through `UI.empty`).

**Server changes needed (I don't own these files):**
1. `server/checks/s10.py` `check(c)` calls `main()`, which asserts `SATF_DB` ends in `s10.db`. `test_flow` under any other database fails there.
2. `GET /api/drill/{id}` doesn't return `cfg.walk` (items, i, step). The walk page can't be built without it.
3. `POST /api/drill/preview` with `source:'due'` returns no `blocks` and ignores `drop`. The preview currently falls back to today's list.
4. `/api/review/due` items lack `seed`. The page finds the question through the family endpoint's latest miss, which may belong to another trap on the same template.
5. `/api/review/item` `story` covers every trap on the template. It should be filtered by norm.
6. These are done on the page for now and should move to the server:
   - `/api/review/redo` has no `causes`, so the cause bar only shows when every row fits in one page.
   - History's `by_difficulty` gives counts only, not `{n, right}`.
   - Fixed has no `status`/`sort` query, so they sort and filter the rows loaded (up to 100).
   - No `sort` on Marked, Saved or History.
7. There is no `GET` for type rules; the Your rules view needs one.

**Needed from other owners:**
- **F3 (runner.js):**
  - Its default pane twin sends `want` as a bare string, which returns 422. The page works around it with `twinBody`.
  - The twin tile header shows "L3" (a level students shouldn't see).
  - The pane's button reads "Fresh one like this" instead of R42's "Twin".
- **F1:** `UI.fracText` doesn't exist. The page calls it only when present, so fractions stay flat for now.

One `test_flow` run on a reused `s10.db` failed at `server/checks/s4.py:498`; on a fresh database it passed, so it looks like leftover test data rather than code.
